headline: Revenue scales sharply as losses widen and capex surges
summary_short: CoreWeave's Q1 FY2026 revenue more than doubled y/y to $2,078M and EBITDA rose 134.5% to $1,027M, but GAAP net loss widened to $740M from $315M a year earlier, while capex rose to $7,695M and long-term debt rose 185.4% y/y to $24,859M.
summary_long: Revenue rose 111.6% y/y to $2,078M; gross profit rose 89.2% to $1,362M. EBITDA margin was 49.4% (vs 44.6% a year earlier); operating margin was -6.9% (vs -2.7%). EPS (diluted) was -$1.40, +6.0% y/y and roughly flat q/q. Cash was $2,244M, +75.9% y/y and -28.2% q/q. Capex was $7,695M (+446.9% y/y); long-term debt was $24,859M (+185.4% y/y). Weighted diluted shares were 527M, +111.6% y/y.
